title: $f^!$ with rational coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with its condensed coefficient ring and pulled-back module-object interpretation of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $X,Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-morphism, in that standing setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Write $\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ for the full subcategory of bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and $\Loc(\Dctf(T,\Lambda))$ for its full localizing closure [sk-def-localizing-closure]. The right adjoint $f^!$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence] on these localizing categories satisfies
$$
f^!\bigl(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)\bigr)\subseteq\Dctf(X,\Lambda).
$$
Its restriction is right adjoint to $Rf_!:\Dctf(X,\Lambda)\to\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: The finite-type separated structure maps give qcqs X and Y. Either coefficient disjunct embeds into IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient without changing the continuous-map convention. The fourth conjunct of compactification_localizing gives preservation of Dctf by the actual compactification lower shriek.

Their composites with the full inclusion into the localizing closures are definitionally the original functors: both equalities are rfl, including their maps. The defining intersection of the localizing closure contains Dctf. Apply Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful along ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulιOfLE to obtain the required restricted adjunction.
